sentences.en: Sometimes I wonder when the first world championship in cyberbullying will take place.
sentences.zh: 有时候我想知道世界上第一次网络欺凌世界锦标赛什么时候举行。

sentences.en: Tom is cyberbullying me with fake accounts.
sentences.zh: 汤姆用假账号在对我进行网络欺凌。

sentences.en: The school has strict rules against cyberbullying to protect students online.
sentences.zh: 学校有严格的反网络欺凌规定，以保护学生在线安全。
